newsitem.title: USA: Yields rise on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.
newsitem.headline: Yields rise on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.

text.p: Yields on the Bond Buyer municipal bond indices edged up this week.
The yield on the 20-bond index of general obligation bonds calculated Thursday, Oct 24, was 5.75 percent, up three basis points from last Thursday.
The yield on the 11-bond index of GO bonds was 5.64 percent, up two basis points from last Thursday.
The yield on the 30-year revenue bond index was 6.01 percent, up four basis points from last Thursday. 20 Bond Index 5.75% 5.72% 10/24/96
